pathFields.label: search
pathFields.description: Search transfer ID, signature, provider reference, source or destination address, memo, counterparty ID, or counterparty display name. Use at least 3 non-whitespace characters; a blank value is treated as no search filter.

pathFields.label: token
pathFields.description: Filter by token symbol or mint.

pathFields.label: status

pathFields.label: category
pathFields.description: Filter by wallet transfers or ramp transfers.

pathFields.label: type

pathFields.label: counterpartyId
pathFields.description: Filter transfers tied to a specific counterparty.

pathFields.label: providerReference
pathFields.description: Provider quote or transaction reference. Must be supplied with provider for exact ramp transfer lookup.

pathFields.label: includeObserved
pathFields.description: When custodyWalletId is supplied, also include RPC-observed activity for that exact wallet row's address. Observed rows have custodyWalletId null.

pathFields.label: sortBy
pathFields.description: Field used to sort the transfer list.
